# # Schema Change: Move Avatar Source from User to Realm Level

## Context

We're changing how default avatar sources work. Currently `default_avatar_source` lives on each `UserProfile`, but it should really be a realm-level setting — organizations choose whether to use Gravatar or generated avatars, not individual users.

The migration `zerver/migrations/0776_realm_default_avatar_source.py` adds the field to Realm and the corresponding removal happens from UserProfile.

## What I Need

This field is referenced in more places than you'd expect. I need the full picture:

1. **Schema change**: The migration file and both model files (`realms.py` for the addition, `users.py` for the removal).

2. **Direct references**: The core avatar logic in `lib/avatar.py` that reads this field. Also check the API examples — some may reference avatar source in example payloads.

3. **Indirect references**: This is where it gets interesting. We have importers for migrating from other chat platforms (Slack, Mattermost, Rocket.Chat) and each one sets `default_avatar_source` during import. All of them need updating. Also check frontend templates and any dependency changes (we're patching a JavaScript library for avatar generation).

4. **Test coverage**: We need updates in upload tests, importer tests, and event tests.

Write your findings to `/workspace/zulip/SCHEMA_IMPACT.md`.


Search only these repositories: github.com/sg-evals/zulip--f2a5dc94

The findings are written above (the full markdown content is the artifact). Here is a summary of what was found across the codebase:

---

## `default_avatar_source`: User → Realm — Impact Summary

### 1. Schema Change
- **Migration**: [`zerver/migrations/0776_realm_default_avatar_source.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--f2a5dc94/-/blob/zerver/migrations/0776_realm_default_avatar_source.py) — adds `default_avatar_source` CharField (`"G"`/`"J"`, default `"G"`) to `realm`.
- **`realms.py`** ([lines 723–737](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--f2a5dc94/-/blob/zerver/models/realms.py?L723-737)): field + constants + `property_types` entry added. All correct.
- **`users.py`** ([lines 655–666](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--f2a5dc94/-/blob/zerver/models/users.py?L655-666)): `DEFAULT_AVATAR_SOURCE` class constant (`"G"`) and per-user `avatar_source` field still present. The class constant is the pending removal target; the `avatar_source` field itself stays.

### 2. Direct References
- [`zerver/lib/avatar.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--f2a5dc94/-/blob/zerver/lib/avatar.py): `avatar_url()` reads the per-user `avatar_source` field (correct — not the realm default). `get_avatar_field()` branches on `UserProfile.AVATAR_FROM_*` constants — no immediate change needed unless those constants are removed later.
- [`zerver/actions/user_settings.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--f2a5dc94/-/blob/zerver/actions/user_settings.py?L444-458) and [`zerver/lib/create_user.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--f2a5dc94/-/blob/zerver/lib/create_user.py?L208-210): already read from `realm.default_avatar_source` — **no changes needed**.
- [`api_docs/changelog.md`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--f2a5dc94/-/blob/api_docs/changelog.md?L119-123): Feature level 456 documents the new realm setting.

### 3. Indirect References — the real work

**Four importers all hardcode `UserProfile.DEFAULT_AVATAR_SOURCE` and need updating:**

| File | Lines |
|---|---|
| [`zerver/data_import/slack.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--f2a5dc94/-/blob/zerver/data_import/slack.py?L505-524) | 505, 524 |
| [`zerver/data_import/mattermost.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--f2a5dc94/-/blob/zerver/data_import/mattermost.py?L91) | 91 |
| [`zerver/data_import/rocketchat.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--f2a5dc94/-/blob/zerver/data_import/rocketchat.py?L95) | 95 |
| [`zerver/data_import/microsoft_teams.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--f2a5dc94/-/blob/zerver/data_import/microsoft_teams.py?L299-353) | 299, 353 |

All should replace `UserProfile.DEFAULT_AVATAR_SOURCE` with `Realm.AVATAR_FROM_GRAVATAR` (or derive from the realm object).

**Frontend** (all already correctly reference `realm_default_avatar_source`): [`admin.ts`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--f2a5dc94/-/blob/web/src/admin.ts?L65), [`settings_org.ts`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--f2a5dc94/-/blob/web/src/settings_org.ts?L248-251), [`settings_components.ts`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--f2a5dc94/-/blob/web/src/settings_components.ts?L915), [`settings_config.ts`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--f2a5dc94/-/blob/web/src/settings_config.ts?L1408), [`state_data.ts`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--f2a5dc94/-/blob/web/src/state_data.ts?L486), [`organization_settings_admin.hbs`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--f2a5dc94/-/blob/web/templates/settings/organization_settings_admin.hbs?L82-91).

**JS dependency**: [`package.json`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--f2a5dc94/-/blob/package.json?L54) has `jdenticon@^3.3.0`. No `patches/jdenticon.patch` exists yet — if one is planned, it is not yet committed.

### 4. Test Coverage
- [`test_upload.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--f2a5dc94/-/blob/zerver/tests/test_upload.py?L1655-1695), [`test_events.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--f2a5dc94/-/blob/zerver/tests/test_events.py?L1594-1599), [`test_realm.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--f2a5dc94/-/blob/zerver/tests/test_realm.py?L2373-2375), [`test_transfer.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--f2a5dc94/-/blob/zerver/tests/test_transfer.py?L47-49): all correctly use `Realm.*` constants and `do_set_realm_property`.
- **Gap**: No importer test files reference `default_avatar_source`. Tests should be added for all four importers to assert the realm-level default is applied when no user-specific avatar exists.
